_README: Copy to /usr/local/etc/fleet_alarm.json on bsd and tune. Thresholds are ACTUAL battery mV; see fleet_alarm.md. Devices NOT listed under low_vcc.devices are never battery-checked (mains devices IrrCntrl/PowerMonitor whose last column is not vcc). caliper reports no vcc column. Email uses bsd's already-configured mailer (sendmail -> ssmtp); this daemon holds no SMTP credentials.

event._color: light blue, deliberately NOT red -- Claude Code's attention banner is red (#d62828) and the two are otherwise indistinguishable at a glance. popup_banner.py picks dark text for light backgrounds.

stale._README: Silence alarm -- the only thing that catches a dead device (a flat pack stops posting, it does not post a low reading). max_silence_s is in SECONDS and must be ~2x the device's own reporting interval so one missed report is not an alarm. WaterLeak pings weekly (HEARTBEAT_S in its main.cpp) -> 14 days.
